# Suites the integration lane must execute (issue #210).
#
# Each line names one top-level test that .github/workflows/integration.yml has to run for real. The gate
# (.github/scripts/integrationgate) reads this file and the `go test -json` output of the lane, and fails when a
# listed test was never executed, was skipped (an unset resource looks like a skip, which looks like a pass),
# failed, or no longer exists. It also fails when a top-level test in a file built with `//go:build integration`
# is missing from this list, so a test cannot move behind the tag and silently run nowhere.
#
# Format: module-dir | package-dir | TestName
#   module-dir   directory of the Go module that holds the test, relative to the repository root ("." is the root)
#   package-dir  directory of the package inside that module ("." is the module root)
#   TestName     a top-level test function, TestXxx (subtests travel with their parent)
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. A suite may be listed once.
#
# example/cluster: PostgresEventStore against a real PostgreSQL. The tests skip when EGO_EXAMPLE_POSTGRES_DSN is
# unset; the workflow starts a Postgres service and sets it.
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_Conformance
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_ConcurrentExpectRevisionHasExactlyOneWinner
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_ExpectGenesisConflictsOnExistingID
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_TenantScopeIsolatesRecords
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_UnconditionalWriteCannotBreakExpectRevision
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_UnconditionalMixedBatchesDoNotDeadlock
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_PartialDeleteKeepsRevision
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_TotalDeleteKeepsRevision
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_DeleteKeepsRevisionPerTenant
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_PersistenceIDs_ZeroPageSize_WithData
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_UnconditionalRaceDistinctSequenceConflict
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_UnconditionalRaceSameSequenceConflict
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_DeleteEventsLocksRevisionAgainstConcurrentWrite
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_TenantMetadataRoundTrips_UnconditionalWrite
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_TenantMetadataRoundTrips_ConditionalWrite
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_TenantMetadataRoundTrips_GetShardEvents
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_TenantMetadataAbsent_ReadsAsNone
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_SchemaMigratesLegacyDatabase
example/cluster | . | TestPostgresEventStore_SchemaMigratesLegacyTenantMetadata
